obligations.requirement: Each active session exposes an explicit dependency footprint.
obligations.oracle: Literal target ObjectId set is retained and inspected only by the conflict policy.
obligations.acceptance: Footprint membership drives decisions without canonical writes.

obligations.requirement: Unrelated ChangeSet continues; target deletion cancels; selected target mutation requests ReResolve.
obligations.oracle: Literal ChangeSet fixtures assert exact Continue/ReResolve/Cancel decisions.

obligations.requirement: Detach, suspend, and source loss terminate capture and stale callbacks cannot resurrect it.
obligations.oracle: Lifecycle notices cancel the active session and late finish/commit are rejected.

obligations.requirement: Generation mismatch by itself does not force conflict and no silent same-target rebase occurs.
obligations.oracle: Generation-only notice yields Continue; target mutation yields ReResolve.
